items.text: Custom AI App Development Services

Off-the-shelf AI rarely fits your exact problem, so we build and modernize AI applications grounded in your data, running on Azure AI Foundry's model catalog, prompt flow tooling, and evaluation pipeline rather than a single hard-coded model call.
Custom Copilots & RAG Apps
Retrieval-augmented generation keeps answers grounded in your own documents and systems instead of generic model knowledge.
AI-Infused Product Features
AI capabilities added directly into the applications your teams already use every day, rather than requiring a rebuild.
Document & Knowledge AI
Search, extraction, and summarization tools that turn unstructured documents into usable answers at scale.

items.text: How We Deliver Your Azure AI Foundry App
A four-step delivery model built for scalability, security, and AI-readiness.
Discovery
We audit your current environment and data, and identify the highest-value use case to start with.
Architecture & Design
Our Azure architects design the solution with scalability, security, and responsible-AI guardrails built in from the start.
AI-Accelerated Build
We build with AI-assisted development, automated testing, and continuous deployment for faster, more reliable delivery.
Launch & Support
We deploy with minimal downtime, train your team, and provide ongoing managed support as the application evolves.
